description: Schema definitions for note handling in a backend application using Marshmallow for serialization and validation.

classes.name: NoteBaseSchema
classes.description: Base schema for note data with title and content fields.

classes.name: NoteCreateSchema
classes.description: Schema used for creating a new note, inheriting from NoteBaseSchema.

classes.name: NoteUpdateSchema
classes.description: Schema for updating an existing note, with optional title and content fields.

classes.name: NoteOutSchema
classes.description: Schema for outputting note data, including id, timestamps, title, and content.

ctags.name: content
ctags.pattern: /^    content = fields.String(required=False, description="Content of the note", validate=validate/

ctags.name: content
ctags.pattern: /^    content = fields.String(required=True, description="Content of the note")$/

ctags.name: content
ctags.pattern: /^    content = fields.String(required=True, description="Content of the note", validate=validate./

ctags.name: id
ctags.pattern: /^    id = fields.String(required=True, description="Unique ID of the note")$/

ctags.name: title
ctags.pattern: /^    title = fields.String(required=False, description="Title of the note", validate=validate.Len/

ctags.name: title
ctags.pattern: /^    title = fields.String(required=True, description="Title of the note")$/

ctags.name: title
ctags.pattern: /^    title = fields.String(required=True, description="Title of the note", validate=validate.Leng/

ctags.name: updated_at
ctags.pattern: /^    updated_at = fields.String(required=True, description="Last update timestamp (ISO-8601, UTC)/

fields.name: content = fields.String(required=False, description="Content of the note", validate=validate/
content = fields.String(required=True, description="Content of the note")
content = fields.String(required=True, description="Content of the note", validate=validate./
id = fields.String(required=True, description="Unique ID of the note")
title = fields.String(required=False, description="Title of the note", validate=validate.Len/
title = fields.String(required=True, description="Title of the note")
title = fields.String(required=True, description="Title of the note", validate=validate.Leng/
